title: The 9 Best Smart Self-Cleaning Litter Boxes
subtitle: App-connected self-cleaning litter boxes that track every visit, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: We pulled the self-cleaning litter boxes on Amazon with Wi-Fi apps and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: cat safety sensors, waste drawer size, health tracking, and odor control.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

buyers_guide.q: Are self-cleaning litter boxes worth it?
buyers_guide.a: For one or two cats, most owners say yes: the box rakes or rotates waste into a sealed drawer after each visit, so you empty it every few days instead of scooping daily. The app also tracks visits and weight, which can flag health problems early.

Look for weight sensors and an infrared or radar sensor that stops the cycle if a cat steps in. Most have a minimum cat weight or age, often around 3 lb or 6 months, so check before buying for a kitten.
Most work with clumping clay litter; some also take tofu or mixed litters. Avoid non-clumping crystals unless the listing says they're supported.
